ns0:svg.ns0:title: India–US activity grew nearly fivefold
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: The five largest two-way country pairs involving the US in 2020 Q1 and 2026 Q1. Each pair has two colored ribbons: coral is public pushes plus opened pull requests from the partner to US-assigned repositories; blue is activity from the US to partner-assigned repositories. Width uses one absolute scale at both dates. The joined shapes compare endpoints, not transfers through time. India’s toward-US share fell from 75 to 72 percent as its combined weight rose.

ns0:g.aria-label: Five busiest two-way US country pairs
Width: public pushes + opened pull requests
Curves join endpoints; intervening quarters not shown.
